whoWeAre.label: 01 — Who we are
whoWeAre.statement: We're Dough — a creative agency shaping brands, stories, and moments from scratch. We don't just follow culture, *we bake it fresh.*
whoWeAre.body: From bold concepts to scroll-stopping content, we work with brands ready to leave a mark, not just make a sale. Agile, obsessive, and unafraid of the unconventional.
whoWeAre.studioBody: Strategy, design and production under one roof in Cairo.
whoWeAre.studioAlt: Two hands pressing into soft dough

reasons.title: Rooted in food & FMCG
reasons.body: We know how food photographs, how a pack sells on shelf and how a launch fills a queue.

reasons.title: Idea to shelf, one team
reasons.body: Strategy, identity, content, packaging and spaces, so the idea survives every handover.

reasons.title: Content made in-house
reasons.body: Photography, video, CGI and AI by our own team, for consistent quality and short timelines.
